༄/ /4 mi bgasama'im4tshogasgo nas gang zag so so la yul gyi skad rigs dang rnam grangs mtha' yas pas chos ston pas/ chos dkon mchog btags pa pa 'di ni gtso bo lung gis bsdus pa yin la/ dge 'dun yang sa bcu pa nas gzhan don go rim du byed pa'i sgrub pa thob pas/ rang la slob ma'i tshogs mkhas shing dul pa mtha' yas pa 'byung ba la byed kyi/ rang der 'gyur ba'i don min pa'i gnad kyis/dar ṭīka du yang / dkon mchog gsum rim gyis grub pa/ zhes gsungs kyi zob pa zhes ma gsungs so/ / lung 'dir ma bris pas thogs 'grel gyi dbur blta/ sa brgyad pa'i sku de mi 'dor na/ de 'phos ma thag gi tshe snga ma'i lus sems rten brten pa'i 'brel ba chad ma chad sogs tsam zhig mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi zhal na yang gsal/ /1zhu' 4 rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ / mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ / don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ / ces gsungs pa'i phyir/yu 'di'i yon tan gsum pa ni/ dar ṭīka las/ sgra dang rnam bapar rtog pa gzhan gyis rkyen gyi rtogs tshul dzogs pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par bya ba ma yin pa'o/ / zhes pa'i don du bsam nas/ spyi don rol mtsho las/rang snang yul du byed pa'i blo la snang ba ltar brjod byed kyi sgra dang rtog pas ji lta ba bzhin rtogs mi nus pa'i yon tan zhes ye shes rang nyid gzhan gyis rtogs dka' ba'i don du sbyar nas ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i yon tan zur du bgrang ba ni sngon med pa'i 'dus ma byas sogs kyi yon tan dgu pa yin la/ dar ṭīka kyi don yang / don dam bden pa 'dis gzigs pa ltar gzhan gyis 295

/ /rtogs mi nus pa'i don yin gyi/ 'di gzhan gyis rtogs mi nus pa'i don ma yina'i/ de'i phyir 'di nyid ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i yon tan yin pas/ de zur du bgrang mi dgos te/ dar ṭīka las/ rang bzhin rnam dag dang glo bur rnam dag dang / ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam pa gsum zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa sogs/ rang don gyi sku yin kyang 'dir gzhan don gyi skur bshad pa'i dgos pa/ dar ṭīka las/ thugs rje dang nus pa gzhan don du bzhag pa ni gzugs kyi sku gdul bya la dngos su snang nas chos ston pa de gnyis kyi lag rjes yin pa'i dbang du byas nas rnam par b.lag pa'o/ / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes gzhan don du bsdus pa ni thugs rje 'jug pa'i rgyu'i dbang du byas pa ste/ zhes 'gro ba'i ngang tshul gzigs pa la sbyar ro/ /6 sgra rtog gis mtha' bzhir bsam du med pa dang / ru 'dir 'umatha' bzhi yang sgras ji lta ba bzhin yod pa dang / med par brjod du med padang / rtog pas ji lta ba bzhin yod pa dang med par bzung du med pa zhes 'dren pa mi rigs te/ thogs 'grel las/ med pa dang / yod pa dang / yod med dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa ste/ rnam pa bzhi ka ltar yang rtog ge'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pas so/ / dar ṭīka pas/med pa dang / yod pa dang / yod med gnyis ka dang / de las gzhan du yangayod med gnyis ka ma yin pa rang bzhin gyis grub par brtags par mi nus pa'i spros pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral pa'o/ / zhes rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha don dam pa'i bden par gsungs pa shin du legs te/ 'di'i thad kyi dpal 'phreng gi mdo thogs 'grel du drangs pa las/ 'jam dpal skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa la ni sems dang yid dang rnar par shes pa mi 296

sa / /bar phyin kha tha'adapyoga'ajug go / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems yid rnam shes gsum la ṭīka byed du mas kun gzhi nyon yid 'jug shes gsum la sbyar ba stug po bkod pa'i mdo ltar/ sems tsam lugs la rung yang 'dir ches ma 'brel bas phung khams skye mched gsum mam/ dus gsum mam/ yang na/ dar ṭīka ltar rten brten pa sogs la sbyar ro/ /1de1 4 rgyan las/ kun tu 'gro dang khas len rtogs dang zil gnon par/ / dbye ba'i rang bzhin don rnam bzhi yi khyad par gyis//zeg pa mchog phyir skyabs rab song ba gang / / de nyid skyabs su song ba rnams kyi mchog ces bya/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang /lu de yang lam rim las/ ji tsam gyis skyabs su song ba'i tshul 'uni/ bsdu ba nas gsungs pa'i tshul bzhi ste/ yon tan shes pa dang /khyad par shes pa dang / khas blangs pa dang / gzhan du mi smra ba'i skyabs su song ba'o/ / zhes gsungs la/ thub dgongs las/ rgyu bzhis skyabs su 'gro bar rigs par bya ste/ yon tan shes pa dang / khyad par shes pa dang /khas blangs pa dang / ston pa gzhan bsten pa ma yin pas so/ / de rnams kyi snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi ma'i rgyu ste zhes sogs gsungs pa snga ma dang don gcig la/'di tsam skyabs 'gro dbyis phyin pa kun la dgos kyang / mdo sde rgyan gyi de theg chen thun mong ma yin dza ste/ dmigs pa'i khyad par sems can kun gyi don sgrub pa'i phyir rang gi mos pa'i yul theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs rdzogs pa'i gegs shes bya'i sgrib pa yang dag pa'i ye shes kyis bcom pa las 'bras bu 'khor zhi ro gcig pa mi gnas pa'i myang 'das 'grub pa'i kun tu 'gro ba bzhi dang / ngo bo'i khyad par 'bras bu'i skyabs de rang la sgrub par khas blangs 297

/ /pa'i tshul gyis skyabs su song bas rgyal ba'i rigs su skye zhing / der skyes ba'i rgyal po'i bu dang blon po chen po ltar yon tan du ma 'grub pa dang / lam du ma zhugs pa dang / zhugs pa na yon tan du ma rim gyis rtogs pa ste thor ba dang / nyan rang zil gnon gyi khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ / blo brtan gyi 'grel bshad las/ bdag med pa nyid rtogs pas na rtogs pa khyad zhugs so/ / zhes bshad kyang / ye shes kun 'gro'i don las gzhan mi snang bas 'thad dka' 'am dpyad/ khyad par rgyas par ni 'grel ba 'grel bshad rnams la blta ste/ 'dir gzhung gi mtshams 'byed tshul dang / don gyi 'brel la dpyod pa'i sgo tsam legs par phye yod do/ /5 phar phyin bsdus pa las/ sems can rnams la snying brtse zhing /bder gshegs yon tan thob mos na/ / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ / mdor bsdus skyabs su song ba yin/ / zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ byang chub mchog gi phyogs kyi chos/ / bdag don ma yin gzhan don du/ / snying rje chen po spyod byed na/ / chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ byang chub sems mchog mi ldog dang / /dbang dang tshad med yon tan gyis/ / brgyan pa'i yon tan gang 'tshol ba/de ni dge 'dun skyabs song yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/shu lung 'di gsum gyi don theg chen pa sangs rgyas la skyabs su ba'agro tshul sangs rgyas zur du bzhag nas lha sku la phyag 'tshal ba ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin gyi/ sems can rnams la snying brtse bas de dag sgol ba'i ched du rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor sgrub par 'dod pa yin pa'i phyir/ rgyan las/ 'di ni de dngos 'dod pas khas len de yang snying brtse las rigs bya/zhes so/ / tshigs bcad gnyis pa'i don yang / ma btung bar phyag 298

༄/ /4 sgo khasags mtshodapyoga'atshal bas sman gyis mi phan pa ltar/ rgyud dang ma 'dres pa'i chos ni skyabs dngos su mi 'gyur bas/ sangs rgyas sman pa des bstan pa'i chos kyi sman la theg pa chen po'i chog bzhin du spyad na shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad sel te/skabs 'di'i skyabs dngos su byas nas skyob tshul yin no/ /gsum pa'i don/rgyangs ring por 'gro ba'i lam grogs ni/ der son gyi bar du mi ldog pa lam bar gyi mthun rkyen rnams la dbang 'byor ba/ grogs la brtse zhing byams pa zhig la brten dgos pa ltar/ 'dir yang phyir mi ldog sogs kyi yon tan can zhig ni/ skyabs 'gro'i yul gyi dge 'dun yin no/ / 'dir tshol ba zhes pa yon tan de dag rang gis tshol ba la byas na gnyis pa dang zlos pas/de 'dra'i yon tan can gyi grogs tshol ba'am/ de 'dra 'tshol ba'i grogs dge 'dun la lam gyi zla grogs zhu ba ci rigs su spyor dgos pas 'di'i 'gyur ha cang bde ba mi snang /1/2 1 dar ṭīka las/ skyabs 'gro 'di la go ba legs par chags na gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa ma lus pa skyabs 'gro byas pa'i yan lag tu shes par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ suba'adi'i gnad kyis chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad ngo bo'i ldog cha'am/rgyu'ildog cha'am/ byed pa ste 'azin las kyi ldog cha nas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ston byed kho na yin no/ / zhes rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gsungs ste/gsung rab gdams par shar ba'i legs bshad do/ / ྅ skyabs kyi don dang yongs su skyob pa'i don nyon mongs nas theg dman gyi bar las skyabs pa dang skyob pa'i don yin te/ rgyan gyi byang chub kyi skabs las/nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ nyon mongs pa'i lam las 299

/ /skyob tshul ston par/ rtag tu nyon mongs tshogs kun dang / las kyi kun nyon nam nyon mongs las skyob tshul ston par/ nyes par spyod pa thams cad dang / / tshe'i kun nyon nam sdug bsngal gyi lam las skyob tshul ston par/rga dang 'chi ba dag las kyang / / sangs rgyas nyid ni yongs su skyob/ / nas/hu 'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang / / ngan song dang ni thabs min bdang / / 'jig tshogs theg pa dman pa las/ / 4 de phyir skyabs kyi dam pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ stsa tshigs bcad phyi ma 'di 'grel ba 'grel bshad sogs las skyes bu gsum la sbyar ba mi snang yang / rkang ba dang po gnyis kyis chung ngu phal ba dang / khyad par can gnyis tshe 'di'i gnod 'tshe sogs dang / phyi mar ngan song las skyob tshul dang / rkang ba gsum pas sgyes bu 'bring rnams 'jig lta sogs nyon sgrib las skyobs tshul dang chen po rnams theg dman gyi yid byed las skyob tshul bstan par gsal la/mdosde rgyan gyi gzhung gong 'og gang na'ang skyes bu gsum la sbyar nas bshad dgos pa shin tu mang bas slar bshad par smon/1sna3 1 yang kho na re/ don dam pa'i skyabs gsum 'gal bar thal/ kun dzob pa'i skyabs 'gal ba'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ rkusems tsam pa dang mdo sde spyod pa ba rnam shes bdag gi mtshan gzhir 'dod pas kun rdzob pa'i skyabs gsum ga'i gzhi mthun du 'dod dgos par snang la/rnal 'byor spyod ba pa de ltar ma yin par phung po'i tshogs tsam gyi nga zhig 'jog ste/ 'grel chen las/ rgyun nyid kyis ni gang zag zhes bya ba ni gcig go / zhes dang / phar phyin lam ṭīka las/ slob dpon gyis phung po'i rgyun gang zag la 'jog pas gang zag bden par 'dzin pa ni phung po las 300

sa / /ba pa cas 'tshogasgong bden par 'dzin pa yin la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/1dī4 ྅ rnam 'grel las/ yul mthong ba bag chags tsam las/ don gyi nus pa ltos med na/ / bar chad la sogs yod na yang /dbang shes blo ni skye bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khye 'dir drangs pa'i lung gi 'brel dang / 'og tu/ dang po'i bag tsam srog chags phal cher la/ / zhes pa ltar pha ma las thob pa'i 'phangs 'bras kyi mig gis bdag rkyen byas pa'i mig shes phal ba zhig skabs 'di'i sha'i mig shes tsam po de yin par mngon/ 1dī6 ྅ rgyan las/ dbang po lnga rnams gzhan 'gyur na/ / don kun 'jug dang thams cad kyi/ / yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung / / zhes dang /ga 'dir cha ba'i phar phyin las/ yang na brgya phrag dang / bcu bganyis zhes phye nas/ mtshan so gnyis dang /mi dpe byad brgyad cu ste/yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis zhes kyang bshad rung bas/ de lta na go sla ba nyid do/ / zhes bshad kyang / dbyig 'grel las/ de la'ang so sor yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung ba la/ zhes 'byung zhing / blo brtan gyis kyangagazungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang / pad dkar la zhal 'phang mdzad pa'i snga mar mi gsal yang / phyi ma 'dir drangs pa 'di yin pas thun mong du sbyar ba dang / grangs bsdus pa mi 'thad par sems so/ /1sna7 4 dbye na gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa ma gtogs pa'i shes pa dgu yod/ nge gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa dang yul zhumatshungs pa'i mngon sum yod na/ las 'bras kyi 'brel ba phra mo rtogs pa'i de yod par 'gyur zhing / 'dir chos kyi spyan gsar thob nas yod pa'i dbye 301

/ /ba bstan pa'o zhes kha cig 'dod la/ dbang po'i rim pa rtogs pa'i tshe chos la gus pa dang chos spangs pa'i rnam smin gyis dbang po no rtul du 'gyur ba dang / tshe snga mar sbyangs pa dang ldan mi ldan/ bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa ji lta bu ldan pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams la sogs pa shes pas las kye rnam par smin pa dang / tshe snga ma dang / 'chi 'pho ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams du ma shes pa sogs yod kyang / de'i yul la las 'bras kyi 'brel ba 'ong don med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin nam dpyad/1dī9 2 yum 'di la spyod pa'i byang chen mngon par shes pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'thob ste/ nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ / nas/ dge slong sum brgyas chos gos byon pa phul nas sems bskyed pas/ bskal ba drug cu rtsa gcigagi rjes su bskal ba skar ma de lta bu la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal chenapo zhes bya bar lung bstan pa'i bar gyi mdo las mngon shes drug bshad pa'i don ston par/ rtsa 'grel 'di byung /ce 'di mdo sde skal bzang las/ skal ba bzang po 'di'i 'og tu bsangs rgyas med pa'i skal ba drug cu 'byung ngo / / de'i 'og tu skal ba snyan pa chen po zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ skal ba gcig po de la sangs rgyas khri 'byung ngo /skal ba snyan pa chen po de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas med pa'i skal ba brgyad khri 'byungango / / de'i 'og tu skal ba skar ma lta bu zhes bya ba 'byung ngo / /bskal ba de gcig la sangs rgyas brgyad khri 'byung ngo / zhes gsungs pa 'di dang cung mi 'dra pa dpyad dgos la/ 'di mngon shes la 'doms par 'gro tshul ni/ nyi snang las/ de'i dus su lung bstan pa'i gdams ngag gi 302

da / /ba pa tha ra2tswapyongaga'abras bu dus gzhan du thob par bstan pa'i don gyis gsungs pa yin no/zhes ma 'ong ba chags thogs med par gzigs pa'i mngon shes rang la mnga' bar bstan pa'i sgo nas gdul bya la yang de sgrub par 'doms pas bsdu ba bzhi'i nang gi don mthun don spyod gnyis yin no/ /5 mdzod las/ bsam gtan dag gis lam rnams sla/ / sa gzhan dag gis dka' ba yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ che mdzod kyi b.lung 'di mthong bzhin du da dung 'di lam spyi'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/mngon shes nyer bsdog la brten pa mi srid ces yig 'jog mkhan mang pos bris snang ba mi 'thad de/ 'di'i rtsa ba chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag lam ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ mngon par shes pa bul la dka' ba'i lam dang / mngon par shes pa myur la dka' ba'i lam dang / mngon par shes pa bul la sla ba'i lam dang / mngon par shes pa myur la sla ba'i lam mo zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 6 khyab ste/ dī de'i mjug tu/ blo rtul mngon shes bul ba dang / / gcig shos kyis ni mngon shes myur/ / zhes 6skye dka' la myur ba dang bul ba gnyis bshad pa'i phyir/1sna 6 'bum gyi gnod 'joms las/ byang chub sems dpa' yongs su dag pa rnams kyi mngon par shes pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la sogs pa sa gong ma rnams kyi mthu la sogs pa shes pa la thogs pa med de/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 1 'dir 'jig rten pa'i thugs mngon du mdzad pa de nyid byang sems kyi mngon shes kyi yul du 'gyur ba'i don yin par bla ma rnams gsungs la/ 'jig rten pa'i thugs mngon du byas tshul yang / gzhi bsdu bar/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'jig rten pa'i thugs 303

/ /kyis 'ong bar bya ba'i dgongs pa bskyed pa rigs pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes dang /mdzod 'grel du/ 'jig rten pa'i sems mngon du byas pa'i tshe 'phags lam med kyang thob pa ldan par bshad pa ltar na/ sems bye brag pa kun dzob rnam can zhig bzhag dgos la/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ lha dag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs gnang bas/ thugs la bltas nas/ zhes pa nas/ gzhan du na bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs sus kyang shes par mi nus so/zhes pa ltar na/ 'jig rten pa'i thugs mngon du byas pa'i don/ thugs de dag gis rtogs nus par byin gyis brlabs pa tsam la bya yi/ shes pa mi 'dra ba zhig bskyed dgos pa min la/ lung 'di ltar na de ltar byas tshe lha phal bas kyang rtogs nus la/ spyir sems can sus kyang rtogs mi nus pa 'dra zhig 'dug pas zhib dpyod dgos/1rdokha 4 dbye na/ rdzu 'phrul gyi de/ lha'i rna ba'i de/ bhe'adir bdag rkyen lha'i rna ba sogs ni/ 'phangs 'bras kyi rna dbang de'i than kor tu bsam gtan gyis sa bsdus pa'i 'byang brgyur byas pa las sha khrag sogs dang ma 'brel ba'i dbang po dwangs pa me long dang / gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du 'byung ba yin gyi byang sems kha cig dang / 'khor sgyur dang /khyim bdag lta bu lha'i mig dang 'dra bas der btags pa tsam ma yin par mdzod 'grel las gsungs so/ / 1shā2 5 yang kha cig na re/ yongs 'dzin gyi khyad par de gnyis la theg chen gyi lam gyi lus yongs rdzogs ston pa'i bshes gnyen yod pa dang med pas zer/ chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la bsams te/ la las ston pa mchog sprul gyis de ltar ston pa yod med kyis zer/ la las theb304

༄ / /ba paci gakha tshoXsgogale'u brgyad ma ma mthong bar 'grel chung dang / rgyan snang tsam la bltas nas slob dpon gyi lugs la phyi'i yongs 'dzin kho na'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags tshul bshad pa yin la/ 'phags pas nyi snang du rkang pa dang pos nang gi yongs 'dzin thabs mkhas dang / gnyis pas phyi'i yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen bstan par gsungs pas phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin tshang ma tshang gi sgo nas khyad 'byed dgos pas/ 5 'phags seng ge lugs gnyis tha dad pa skad zer ro/ /6 der thal de ltar mdo nyi khri las gsungs shing / de dang sbyar ba'i tshe mdo'i dbang gis 'phags seng gnyis kyang bzhed tshul mtshungs par gsal pa'i phyir te/ 1na5 4 'grel ba las/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang bral ba dang / zhes so/ / de 'dir le'u brgyad ma drangs pas slob bdapon gyi bzhed pa yang 'phags pa dang mthun par bstan cing / 'grel bar yongs su 'dzin pa dang bral gsungs pa yang gnyis ka yongs 'dzin du mtshungs pas tshigs gcig la bsdus pa yin gyi/ phyi'i yongs 'dzin kho nar sbyorab mi 'thad pas/ de go ched du le'u brgyad ma drangs pa'i don bsdur 'grel chung drangs so/ /1ba5྅ ྅ 'di'i spyor lam bzhi dang mthong spang gzungs 'dzin gyi rtog pa mngon 'gyur bzhi rim bzhin nyams smod kyi spong gnyen du spyor ba'i phyir/ ne thal 'gyur ba dmigs pa so so ba bsdus nas dang / rnam bapa rigs pa'i rnam grangs mang nyung yod kyang / mthong lam du mthong spang bden 'dzin spong zhing / spyor lam du nyams smod pa 'dra bas/ rnam rtog bzhi dang ldan tshul gyi khyad dka' ste/ grogs sogs kyi stobs kyi nus pa che 305

/chung zhig 'byed rgyu yin nam dpyad/ dman pa'i lam gyis gang zag gi bdag 'dzin rags pa mngon 'gyur pa de'i tshe nyams smod par rang rgyud pa 'dod kyang / chags bral sngon song du mi 'gyur tshul gye zhib cha dgos/mkhasagrub rtog ge snang bar/ spang byar ldan pas de'i khyad chos su 'gro na shes sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi khyad chos su 'gyur zhes bkag nas/ rang lugs ye shes de'i nges ngor bden med rtogs kyang snang ngor gzung 'dzin kun byang sogs su bden par snang ba la byed ces rang yin gye tshul du gsungs shing / mthong spang sogs su gsungs de'i zag pa dang bcas pa la bkral lo/ /1spro0 sgra gcig bu brjod tshe de yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ sdeste/ spyir sgra byas pa yin zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ ka bum sogs kyi byas pa yin pa gcod pas khyad par gzhan spong yin kyang sgra gcig bu dmigs kyis bkar te byas sam ma byas dris pa la byas pa yin zhes brjod pa'i tshe brjod 'dodakyi dbang gis ka bum sogs kyi byas pa gcod don med pas khyad par gzhan mi spong yin te/ spong mi spong brjod 'dod kyi dbang gis ma gtogs sgra'i ngos nas 'byed dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /1/ 2 4 shes sgrib gzung rtog yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/skabs lnga pa nas bshad pa'i shes sgrib 'jug pa gzung rtog dgu dang / shes sgrib ldog pa gzung rtog dgu yod pa'i phyir te/ 122 6 shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa gnyis dmigs yul kho na'i sgo nas 'jog pa'i phyir/khyab ste/ pho de ltar byas na de'i yul la gzung 'dzin gnyis su phye ba'i bgazung ba kho na ma gtogs mi yong dgos pa gang zhig 6 skye mched 306

sa / /phar raḥbasnyer sgogabacu gnyis kyi gzugs sogs yul drug gzung ba dang / mig sogs yul can drug 'dzin pa yin pa'i phyir te/ gser 'phreng las/ skye mched dang /shes pa dang / shes bya dang / bdag dang bdag gi pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/dang po ltar na yul drug gzung ba dang / dbang po drug 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa ltar na bem po thams cad gzung ba dang / rig pa thams cad 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa ltar na bdag ni gzung ba dang / bdag gi ba ni 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/1shā& ྅ 'dzin rtogs la rdzas 'dzin dang rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i khyad par ma phyed pa kha cig na re/ 1shā4 1 nyi snang las/ chos thams cadabadag med pa yin no zhes so so skye bos kyang rtog pa min nam/ nas/so so skye bo de dag gis ni mos pa yid la byed pa yin la/ 'dir 'phags pa ni de kho na yid la byed pa brjod par 'dod pas bo de gnyis la btags jipa tsam du 'char tshul shugs che chung ches mi 'dra ste/ de'i phyir khyod kyi rtsod pa 2 snying bo med do/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / ྅ nyi snang las/ de'i tshig ni tha snyad pa pha rol pos go ched yin gyi don dam pa dngos gnas la nga'o snyam du zhen nas min pa des na snying po med do/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 4 rnam bshad las/ spyir 'dzin rtog gnyis ga'ang skye 'phags gnyis ga'i rten can du shes par bya'o/ / zhes gsungs ba'i phyir/1༈4 6 nyi snang las/ gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa yin la 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni ma yin pa zhes bya ba mu bzhi ste/ mu dang po ni/gzugs la sogs pa'i yul drug go / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ me zhi ba༅7

/ /snang gi lung des gzugs sogs yul drug las tshig zin la ma bstan yang /de longs spyad byar bden par zhen pa'i yul can gzung rtog dang por go ba'i don no/ /1ldo5 6 mdo las/ gzung rtog spyir bstan pa'i rtog pa yin na/rnam byang gzung rtog yin dgos pa'i phyir te/ tse gser 'phreng las/ba'adi'idon gzung rtog tshan gnyis kyi dang po dngos tsam la brten pa zhes pa/de ni kun byang gnyis ga'i yul can dang / gnyen po'i rten can ni rnam byang kho na'i yul can yin pas dang po gang yin des gnyis pa'i dmigs par yang dmigs la gnyis pa gang yin des dang po'i dmigs pa cha tsam la ma dmigs pas khyab par gsungs so/ / 'og tu nyon mongs gzung rtog dgu gsungs yang / nyi snang las/ dngos po tsam la brten pa zhes 'byung zhing / tsam sgra'i don kun byang bye brag tu ma bcad par thun mong du dmigs pa la gsungs so/ / de mtshan nyid kyi dbang du byas zhes pa'i gcig pu de yin gye/ dgu tshan dang po de ma yin no/ / snyam na/ 'dir dngos po zhes pa rtsa ba'i gzhi zhes pa'i 'brel ba yin zhing / de ni/ so sor rnam pa dgu/ zhes pa'i de sgra gong gi gzhi la'ang 'jug dgos pa'i phyir te/ gser 'phreng steng nas dpyad rgyu du ma yod mod kyang ma spros/1rdo 1 gzung pa rang bzhin med pa man chad kyi chos thos pas gso bar bya ba rang rgyal gyi rigs zer ba la/ yang kha cig na re/ rang rgyal gyi rigs gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i chos thos pas gso ba'i don/gzung pa phyi don med pa dang / bden med gang rung dgos pas mi 'thad zer/ tshe 'di la yig cha rnying bar rga shi ma rig pa'i 'khrul snang tsam las/ba308

sa / / sar sgomatha'ams gdon gzhan gyis stong bar rtogs pa la byed gsungs pa ni/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ / zhes sogs kyi thad dang 'grig par snang ngo / /1shā 1 mngon rtogs bcu'i nang gi chos dang don dang de kho na nyid dang / rjes la dang / dkon mchog dang / kun tu mi 'byung ba dang / mthar thug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bdun dang / nyan thos kyi mngon rtogs/ rang rgyal gyi mngon rtogs/ sangs rgyas kyi mngon rtogs te bcu po de yin pa'i phyir/1rdo9 6 dpe dgu tshan gnyis kyis kyang bstan pa'i phyir/ dworigs 'di dpe'i sgo nas ston par/ rgyud bla ma las/ de yi rang bzhin chos sku dang / / de bzhin nyid dang rigs kyis ste/ / zhes pa'i chos sku la drang nges kyi mdo gnyis/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa ste gsum/ de bzhin nyid dang bzhi/ rigs la rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / rgyas 'gyur gnyis te drug rgyas 'gyur la yang / chos skur 'gyur rung dang / gzugs sku gnyis la 'gyur rung ste/ don dgu bo mtshon byed dpe dgu ston par/sangs rgyas sprang rtsi snying po bzhin/ / gser bzhin gter bzhin ljon pa bzhin/ / rin chen sku dang 'khor lo yis/ / bsgrur ba bzhin dang gser gzugs bzhin/ / zhes byung / rigs de sgrib byed dgu 'chad par/chags dang sdang dang rmongs dang de'i/ / kun sdang drag dang bag chags dang / / mthong sgom lam spang ma dag dang / / dag pa'i sa la brten pa yi/dri ma rnam dgu zhes byung / kun sdang drag dang zhes dug gsum gyi mngon 'gyur pa gsum gcig tu grangs so/ / de mtshon byed dgu ston par/ pad+ma sogs chags bung ba dang / / spun pa dang ni mi gtsang dang / / 'bras shun 309

/ /gos hrul bud med kyi/ / mngal dang sa yi spubs na yang / / zhes byung /de dag mtshon tshul sogs rgyud bla rtsa 'grel du gsal lo/ /6 rgyud bla ma las/ de ltar rgyal ba'i snying po yi/ / rnam bzhag rnam pa bcu zhes brjod/ we nām bzhag nam sna bsto'i sto nas rigs gtan la phashā ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ ngo bo rgyu 'bras las ldan 'jug pa dang / / gnās skabs de bzhin kun tu 'gro ba'i don/ / rtag tu mi 'gyur yon tan dbyer med ni/ / zhes pas mdor bstan nas/ rgyas par/ rin chen nam mkha' chu dag bzhin/ / zhes sogs rang spyi gnyis kyi sgo mas ngo bo la sbyar/ zeg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ / zhes sogs rgyu la sbyar/ gtsang bdag bde dang rtag nyid kyi/ / zhes sogs kyis 'bras bu'i don du bshad pa sogs legs bshad bla na med pa du ma rje btsun dam pa'i zhal las thos kyang shog chung 'di'i 'dab tu ma shod/bdun/ 1/nardo rdogu/ 5 zhe~X ༵ dīXs/ da~X rdo /༵ ༷༷༷ /gudīng ri/dī ༵༵ yod/1shā1 2 mdo las/ skye mched drug gi khyad par gang yin pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhe 'di'i don yang na skye mched drug la babatags pa'i gang zag gi gdags gzhi'i rnam shes steng du bag chags 'jog ces pa'i don yin gsung / 4 sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas 'gyur sprul skur btsun pa bzhed pa'i phyir/ ze zhes gsungs pa 'di ltar na/ mig shes jikyi steng na yang sangs rgya rung gi bag chags yod pas/ bag chags 'dzin pa'i shes pa la kun gzhir ma nges so/ / 1di2 nywa rigs drug ni go 310

da / /tha pa tsha ramasasbyogasla/ ma zeg pa gsum gyi rigs gsum/ nges ma nges kyi rigs gnyis/ rigs chad dang drug go /1shā2 rtsa sgrub kyis/ dag phyogs sa dang 'od zer dang / /phyug dang mig dang rdo rje dang / / mtho ris chu dang don dgu la/ / mkhas pasago sgra nges par gdags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar go sgra sa la byas nas sas bsdus pa skyob pas der brjod pa'i phyir te/ ma go tra zhes pa'i ga'i na b.royun zhes par bsgyur ba'i ga'i srog tu zhugs/ zhabs kyu ga 'a btags pas/ gu ṇa sas bsdus dang / phyogs sogs la 'jug tra'i ta dang ra so sor phral bas ta ra sgol ba'am skyob pa ste gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ tra ni skyob par byed pa'i don/ /'jig rten spyod las rnam grol bar/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/1du4 ྅ gnyen po bar chad med lam gyi ngos kyi spang bya skye 'gyur gyis spong ba dbu sems kyi lugs dang / 'gag 'gyur gyis spong ba bye smra'i lugs gnyis ka zhamagacig tu bsres pa'i phyir/ re dngos gnyen skye ba bal mngon du phyogs pa dang / de'i spang bya 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshul gyis spong pa ni/ skye 'gyur gyi spong lugs dang / spang gnyen gnyis cig car mdzo sbrel g.yang la lhung ba ltar 'gag pa ni 'gag 'gyur gyi spong lugs so/ / (na bdag nyid chen po zhesa'adug pasablo ldan shes rab yin nam dpyod/) 1shā6 6 gser 'phreng las 'di byang ye'i bzhed par bshad do/ /2shā0 ྅ mngon mtho la ltos nas kyang der nges/ ༷ mdo sde 311

/rgyan las/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang / / 'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang / / rtag tu nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'grodang / / bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o/ / 'di mngon mtho la ltos pa'i drang nges sgrub byed dang / ྅ don gnyis sgrub pas kyang der nges/she 'di'i sgrub byed/ sems can don ni rab brtson pa'i/ / gtong dang mi gnod bzod pas byed/ / gnas dang grol ba gzhir bcas pa/ /rang don rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ / zhes gsungs/ ྅ gzhan don rnam pa thams cad pas kyang der nges/ se 'di'i sgrub byed/ mi 'phongs pa bdang rnam par mi 'tshe dang / / rnam 'tshe bzod dang bya bas mi skyo dang / /dga' byed legs par brjod pa de yi phyir/ / gzhan gye don ni rang gi don yin no/ / zhes gsungs/ ྅ theg chen thams cad sdud pas kyang der nges/ te 'di'i sgrub byed/ longs spyod mngon par mi dga' dang / /b.rab gus gnyis la mi skyo dang / / rnam 'byed rnam par mi rtog pa/ / theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ / zhes gsungs/ ྅ thabs kyi rnam pa thams cad pa'i dbang du byas kyang der nges/ e 'di'i sgrub byed/ yul brnams la ni ma chags lam/ / de thob rnam g.yeng sngon pa'i gzhan/ /sems can mi gtong 'phel ba dang / / sgrib pa rnam par sbyor ba'i gzhan/zhes gsungs/2 ba 1 ྅ rgyu dang / rnam smin dang / smon lam dang / so sor rtogs pa'i sgom pa bzhi dang / go sgom tshul gyi nang gses dbye ba 'di dag la rtsa tshig med kyang / dbyeg 'grel gsal/ 4 lnga pa dbang 'byor 312

da / /tshog pa gang//sgo/da/la sku (ngo bo nyid sku longs sku )dang / spyod pa (sprulasku )dang / ston pa (phyin drug la )dbang 'byor ba sgom pa gsum rnams yod pa'i phyir te/ 5 phyin drug re re la ngo bo nyid dang / rgyu dang / 'bras bu dang / las dang /sbyor ba dang / 'jug pa dang drug gi sgo nas rab tu dbye ba de yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ sbyin pa la sbyar na don rnams gtong bar byed pa dang /kho ('dis ngo bo/) rtsa ba sems pa la brten pa/ / ('dis rgyu/)b.lus dang longs spyod phun tshogs dang / / ('dis 'bras bu/) gnyis rjes 'dzin dang rdzogs byed dang / / ('disalas/) de yang ser sna mang ldan dang / / ('dis ldan pa/) chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs gtong / /'dis 'jug pa'i khyad par bstan zhes dbyig 'grel gsung / 7 bdun pa mi mthun phyogs nyams pa byas tshul yod de/ mi mthun phyogs go longs baspyod la chags shā/ phyi bshol la chags pa / mchog 'dzin la chags shā/ lan la chags ni/ rnam smin la chags shā/ mi mthun phyogs la chags shā/ rnam g.yeng la chags shāste/ kha chags pa bdun ci rigs las grol ba'i phyir te/2rdo2 1 brgyad pa phar phyin gye yon tan rgya che la ngo mtshar ba rang gzhan gyi dga' bde bla na med pa yod de/ so so'i yon tan tshigs bcad nyer gnyis kyis bshad pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ sangs rgyas sras rnams ngo4'dir tshigs bcad nyer gnyis dang / dbyig 'grel du nyer gsum byung yang rtsa bar tshigs bcad so drug 'dug pas bsdu lugs dpyad dgos/ 2zhes sogs nas/ brtson 'grus ldan pa thob pas pham pa med/ / ces pa'i bar 'byung ba'i phyir/ / 'dir shog grangs dang thig 'phring gi ang yig 313

/ /rnams dang / nyin srib kyi rtags su na yig dang nga yig 'jog dgos rnams/bkra shis 'khyil gyi phar phyin skabs dang po'i dpar rnying dang bstun tshe der shog grangs kyi kha yig nor yod pa rnams kyang ma bcos par/ de dang mthun par par du brkos pa lags so/ / mgo li| /314

ra / //pa ba bka snyo/sgo 'a༄/ / bstan pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro'i khrid yig phan bde'i lam bzang gsal pa'i sgon me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya/ mkhyen dang brtse ba 'phrin las phun tshogs ston pa mnyam med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin chen srid zhi'i gdung sel dam pa'i chos/ / rig dang grol pa'i yon tan brgyad ldan 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ / lus dang ngag yid gus pas mchod do 'bral med byang chub bar du skyos/ / gang la brten na nam yang mi bslu ba'i/ / skyabs kyi dam pa mchog gsum dbang gi rgyal/ / dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor legs mchod nas/ / dngos grub gru char 'bebs rnams skal ba bzang / / de slad mos brtson dge ba'i blo gros kyi/ / bgrod pa mi dman zhi ba'i mgron rnams la/ / phan bde'i lam bzang 'jug ngogs gsal ba'i phyir/ / legs bshad gtam gyi sgron me spar bar bya/ / de'ang 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i zhal nas/ / dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhinanor las lhag / 'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin/ / rnyed dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ / tshul 'di bsam nas 'jig rten bya ba kun/ / spun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur nas/ / nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa dgos/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dal 'byor 315

/ /tshang ba'i rten bzang 'di lta bu ni rgyu dpe ngo bo gang gi sgo nas bsams kyang rnyed tshul mi srid pa tsam du dkon la/ don shin tu che ste yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches kyang tshe 'dir dbul ba sel ba tsam ma gtogs phyi mar phan pa cung zad kyang mi nus la/ rten 'di'i steng nas rang gis 'bad thub na zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang yang tshe gcig nyid la 'grub pas gtan gyi bde skyid mtha' dag sgrub nus so/ / rnyed dka' don che ba'i rten bzang bla ma mchog gsum gyi thugs rjer lan cig thob pa 'di'ang 'gal rkyen du 'dzing ba rlung dmar nang gi mar me bzhin nam 'chi cha med pas myur ba myur bar gtan tu phan nges kyi snying po zhig len dgos la/ tshe 'di'i zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang snyan grags sogs ci tsam rgyas kyang 'chi ba'i tshe rmi lam gye dga' ston ltar dran pa'i yul du bzhag nas 'gro ba ma gtogs snying po ci'ang med pa nas kyi spun pa lo brgyar phyar yang nang na snying po len rgyu med pa dang 'dra/de'i tshe phan nges pa de gang yin na spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa du mar rab dgongs mdzad pa yi/ thub dbang rnams kyis 'di nyid phan par gzigs/zhesagasungs pa ltar/ ston pa thugs rje can des rang cag gi don du dang por thugs bskyed/ bar du bya dka' ba'i spyod pa dpag tu med pa spyad/mthar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad de ma bu gcig pa lta bu'i brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas ston par mdzad pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di gnyis ma gtogs gzhan med pas de la nges bar 'jug dgos/der 'jug tshul yang rang gis gang 'dod byas pas mi chog par chos kyis rga ma log pa zhes 'jug sgo ma nor ba zhig nas tshul bzhin du 'jug dgos/de'ang paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ dang po bstan dang theg chen la/ 'jug pa'i sgo dang gzhung shing phyir/ kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin 316

ra / //pas theg gan rna'i/sgo khyepa'i/ / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nan tan bya/ / zhes sogs ltar bstan pa spyi'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro/ theg chen thun mong ba'i 'jug sgo sems skyed/sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'jug sgo dbang yin par gsungs pas/thog ma kho nar rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo gcig bu phan bde legs tshogs ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas skyabs 'gro rnam par dag pa'i rmang gzhi zin pa zhig byed dgos so/ / des na 'di la bzhi/ skyabs su 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ skyabs su 'gro pa'i tshul/ skyabs su song ba'i phan yon/skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya'o/ / dang po ni/ bdag dang ma rgan sems can de dag thams cad dus thog ma med pa zhig nas da lta'i bar du spyir 'khor ba dngakhyad par ngan song gsum la gtan gyi sdod gnas su byas te yun ring la shugs drag pa'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das pa zhig myong 'dug tu zin kyang da dung gnyen pos btsan chod cig ma byung na / myang bas sdug bsngal gyi gting dang mthar thon pa zhig yong mi srid par 'dug da res rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i dus 'dir rang gis rang ma bslus pa byas te 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad spangs pa'i thar pa mchog bla ma sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig thob par ma byas na zangs zab ri rked nas 'gril ba bzhin 'di nas rdog sna zhig 'gred de slar ngan song gi gting du lhung phyin/ de nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa lta zhog / bde 'gro'i sgra tsam yang bskal ba mu mtha' yas par thos dka' ba'i sdug bsngal gyi g.yangs brgyud ma nas brgyud mar ltung nges te rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ de lta'i dge ba nyam chung nyid la rtag /sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rang cag rnams dge ba gang byas shugs chung la/ sdig pa gang byas shugs che zhing yan lag ma tshang ba med la grangs kyang shin tu mang bas/ rgyu de la dpag na 317

/ /phyi ma'i 'gro sa ngan song las ma 'das pa ni/ bzhi brgya pa las/ phal mo cher ni mi rnams ni/ / dam pa ma yin phyogs yongs 'dzin/ / des na so so skye bo rnams/ / phal cher nges par ngan 'gror 'gro/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / der skyes na gzhan dbang kho nar song ste thar mi thub pa'i tshul yang dpal ldan zla bas/ gang tshe rang dbang 'jug cing mthun gnas pa/gal te 'di bdag 'dzin par mi byed na/ / g.yangs bar lhung bas gzhan dbang 'jug 'gyur ba/ / de las phyi nas gang gis slong bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin te/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis brtse bas gzigs kyang rang gi las kyis bsgribs pas skyob thabs dang bral zhing skyabs kyi snang ba mi 'char bar sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag gi snang ba 'ba' zhig shar te bya thabs dang bral ba'i tshul/ spyod 'jug las/ su zhig 'jig chen 'di las bdag / legs par skyob par byed 'gyur zhes/ /bred sha thon pa'i mig bgrad nas/ / phyogs bzhir skyabs dag 'tshol bar byed/ / phyogs bzhir skyabs med mthong nas ni/ / de nas kun tu yi mug 'gyur/ / gnas der skyabs yod ma yin na/ / de tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya/de bas rgyal pa 'gro ba'i mgon/ / 'gro ba skyobs pa'i don brtson pa/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la/ / de ring nyin nas skyabs su mchi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ da lta bde 'gro ngan 'gro gnyis kyi so mtshams/ khe nyen skyid sdug kun gyi 'dam kha rang lag na yod pa'i dus 'dir blo bde ba'i gdeng thob pa zhig byed dgos/ de'ang rang stobs kyi nus pa ci'ang med pas lha dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs la 'jus nas skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang khyed mkhyen snyam du blo 'gel dgos te/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos/ gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba ni/ / rgya 318

༄/ /chasatshamamatsho'i nang na rnam par gnas/ / 'dod chags la sogs mi bzad pa'i// chu srin gyis ni lus zos pas/ / de ring gang la skyabs su mchi/ / zhes dri ba'i tshul gyis gsungs la/ lan du slob dpon dpa' bos/ gang zhig la ni nyes pa kun/ / gtan nas yod ye mi mnga' zhing / / gang la rnam pa thams cad du/ / yon tan thams cad gnas gyur pa/ / gal te sems shig yod na ni/ / de nyid la ni skyabs 'gro zhing / / de bstod de ni bkur ba dang / / de yi bstan la gnas pa'i rigs/ / zhes rang la sems shig yod na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / des bstan pa'i chos de sgrub pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su 'gro dgos par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul la gsum/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'iyul ngos bzung ba/ de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i don gtan la dbab pa/de ji ltar lag tu len pa'i tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni/ spyir 'jigs pa sna re sel ba la sangs rgyas byang sems dang nyan thos kyi gang zag re re tsam la skyabs su song bas chog pa rgya mtshor tshong ba mang po gang po la skyabs su song bas 'jigs pa las thar ba lta bu'i lo rgyus du ma yod pa ltar yin kyang / thar pa'i go 'phang sgrub pa la skyabs dkon mchog gsum ga nges par tshang dgos te/ skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ / thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ / zhes dang / dpe chos 'grel pa las/ rgya gar du 'gro ba la rang dang 'dra ba'i mi gsum dgos zer ba ltar/ 'o skol thar ba'i byang chub 'tshol ba la ston pa sangs rgyas la brten dgos/ lam bstan pa'i chos la brten dgos/ de sgrub pa'i grogs dge 'dun la brten dgos/ zhes gsungs shing / dper na nad gso pa la sman dang sman pa nad g.yog gsum 319

/ /gang rung re yod pas mi chog par gsum ga tshang dgos pa ltar/ nyon mongs pa'i nad zhi ba'i thar pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa la/ thabs de ston pa'i sangs rgyas/ thabs dngos gzhi chos/ de sgrub pa'i grogs dge 'dun gsum ga tshang dgos so/ / skyabs gsum so so'i ngo bo ni rgyud bla ma las/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyes grub/ / gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ / mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan/ / don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces rang don gzhan don gyi yon tan brgyad dang / bsam med gnyis med rtogs med pa/ / dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ / gang zhig gang gi chags bral ba/ / bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos/ / zhes 'gog lam gyi yon tan brgyad dang / ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni/ / ye shes gzigs pa dag pa'i phyir/ / blo ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ / bla med yon tan dang ldan nyid/ / ces rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rim bzhin so so'i ngo bo legs par ngos zin pa dgos kyi/ rten gral du bzhugs pa'i gser sku lta bur go ba'am/ mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings na bzhugs yod zer ba lta bus gar yang mi phyin zhes rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsungs so/ / 'on kyang so sor spros na mang dogs pas rgyud bla'i grel pa rnams su shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa skyabs 'gro'i don gtan la dbab pa ni/ de'ang skyabs 'gro'i tshig bklags pa tsam la skyabs 'gror mi 'jog ga skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo ni paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i dris lan blong ( 2 )bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs las/ skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo po i thi ba/ / bdag nyid lhag par 'jigs pa dang / / dkon mchog skyob pa'i nus ldan du/ / shes las byung ba'i skyabs 'gro la/ / thams cad mkhyen pa khyod nyid bzhed/ / ces 320

da / /shā babasgor bka we/tshonasagasungs te/ rang sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa ni skyabs 'gro gnad du 'gro ba'i rgyu'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo dngos gzhi dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan legs par shes nas yid ches kyi shes rab dang dad pa sogs la 'jog dgos pa'i tshul/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas/dkon mchog gsum gyi khyad par dang yon tan shes pa dang khas blang sogs kyis bsdus pa'i shes rab gtso 'khor ci rigs de skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo yin/zhes gsungs la/ lam rim chen mo las kyang / ji tsam gyis skyabs su song pa'i tshul ni/ bsdu ba nas gsungs pa bzhi ste/ yon tan shes pa dang /khyad par shes pa dang / khas blangs pa dang / gzhan du mi smra bas skyabs su song ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / des na de rnams kyi don cung zad bsdus te brjod pa la bzhi las/ dang po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ni sku mtshan dpes spras shing mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ dpe la bstod pa las/khyod sku mtshan gyis spras gyur pa/ / mdzes gyur mig gi bdud rtsi ni/ /sprin med ston gyi nam mkha' la/ / skar ma'i tshogs kyis spras pa 'dra/ / zhes sogs ltar mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan cing / nyon mongs med pa dang smon gnas mkhyen pa'i byed pa mngon rtogs rgyan las gsungs pa bzhin sku mthong ba tsam gyis nyon mongs zhi zhing thar pa'i sa bon bsgrun pa ste/ mdo las kyang / chos kyi skus rab tu phye bas na mthong bas kyang sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ / thos pa dang reg pas kyang sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ / zhes gsungs shing / rgyu'i dbang du byas na mdo sde bskal bzang dang dbu ma rin chen 'phreng ba sogs su bsod nams kyi 'gyur khyad mtha' yas pa gsungs so/ / gsung gi yon tan ni mdo sde rgyan rtsa 'grel dang sa sde dbu ma snying po sogs su 'byung ba ltar gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i khyad par 321

/rnams dang gtso bor gyur pa ni bden pa po'i le'u las/ 'di ltar sems can kun gyis nges pa'i tshig / mang po dag gis dus gcig zhu zhus na/ /sems kyi skad cig gcig la thugs chud nas/ / gsung dbyangs gcig gis so sor lan kyang 'debs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsung dbyangs gcig gi sgo nas kyang nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can mos pa tha dad pa rnams kyi the tshom dang rmongs pa'i dra ba bcad de gang la gang 'tsham gye yang dag pa'i rtogs pa skyed nus pa ni gzhan don sgrub pa'i sgo mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ / thugs kyi yon tan bden gnyis res 'jog tu ma song par ji lta ji snyed kye rnam pa mtha' dag chags thogs med par gcig car mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa dang / thugs brtse ba chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur te dus rgyun chad med par 'gro ba kun la bu bzhin du dgongs shing / de'i dbangagis 'azin las cung zad kyang dus las yol ba med par gdul bya la 'jug pa'i tshul gsal rgyal gyi bu mo rdo rje ma'i lo rgyus mdo mdzangs blun sogs las 'byung ba ltar ro/ / da lta rang cag 'khor bar lhung ste sdug bsngal du mas non pa 'di'ang sangs rgyas kyis ma dgongs pa min kyang des skyob pa la rgyu rkyenaganyi ga 'dzom dgos pa la rgyu rang gis ma bsgrubs pas lan pa yin te/bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ phyi yi yan lag stobs kun ni/ / khyod kyis yang dag bsgrubs lags te/ / nang gi stobs dag ma tshang bas /byis pa rnams ni sdug bsngal bsten/ / zhes gsungs shing / brag phugs byang bstan du nyi ma mi 'char ba dang dmus long gis nyi 'od mi mthong ba nyi ma la 'od med pas lan pa ma yin par rang rang gi skyon yin pa bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan legs par go na chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad kyis de'i yon tan la las ni ngo bo'i sgo nas 322

ra / // babasgyu thab gobarjod/ la las rgyu/ la las 'bras bu'i sgo nas bajod pas sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar 'ba' zhig tu go bar 'gyur te/ sngon jo bo chen pos kyang bod na mdo rgyud mang po lta rgyu med pas nga'i dad pa nyams song zhes gsungs pa ni/mdo sde ji tsam mang du bltas pa bzhin dad pa rgyas pa'i don yin no/ / mdo nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rang nyid 'jigs pa thams cad las ni grol/ gzhan 'jigs pa las sgol ba'i thabs la ni mkhas/ kun la thugs rje chen po nye ring med par ni 'jug phan btags pa dang ma btags pa thams cad kyi don mdzad pa ste khyad par bzhi 'am/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas skyabs su 'os pa'i rgyu mtshan shes dgos la/ rnam dpyod can rnams kyis tshad ma rnams 'grel las lugs 'byung lugs zlog gnyis kyi sgo nas ston pa tshad ma'i skyes bur sgrub tshul sogs rgya cher bsam ste nges pa gting tshugasapar bya'o/ / de ltar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan shes na de chos kyi mthu las 'byung bar shes nas chos la gus pa sgye zhing / chos de tshul bzhin du sgrub pa po dge 'dun yin pas dge 'dun la'ang gus par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa khyad par shes pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum re re la'ang yon tan tshad med pas gang rung re kho nar skyabs su song bas chog gam snyam na des mi chog ste/ gdul bya'i don du 'gyur tshul gyi sgos chos mi 'dra ba med mi rung re so sor yod do zhes go ba'i phyir khyad par 'di gsungs pa yin no/de'ang rgyud bla ma las/ ston pa bstan pa bslab don gyi/ / theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ / mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ / skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ / zhes gsungs shing / de'i don kha bskangs te bsdu bar/ mtshan nyid/ 'phrin las/ mos pa/ sgrub pa/ rjes su dran pa/ bsod nams 'phel ba las gyur pa'i khyad par drug gsungs pa 323

/ /rnams lam rim las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa khas len pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la yon tan dang khyad par de lta bu yod par shes pa tsam ma yin par/ de ltar shes pa na sman pa mkhas pa'i yon tan mthong ba'i nad pa nyam thag bzhin de rang gi mgon skyabs su 'dzin pa zhig dgos te/ de'ang sangs rgyas ni rang la skyabs ston pa por 'dzin/ chos ni skyabs dngos su 'dzin/ dge 'dun ni skyabs sgrubs pa'i zla grogs su 'dzin pa yin no/ / bzhi ba gzhan du mi smra ba ni/skyabs su bzung ba de'ang mtha' gcig tu dkon mchog gsum kho na la skyabs su 'dzin pa yin gyi/ mu stegs pa'i ston pa sogs skyabs gzhan dang gnyis 'dzin mi byed pa ste/ khyad par 'phags bstod las/ bdag ni ston pa gzhan spangs nas/ / bcom ldan 'das khyod la skyabs su mchi/ / de ci'i slad du zhe na khyod/ / skyon mi mnga' la yon tan ldan/ / zhes dang / mu stegs gzhan gyi gzhung lugs la/ / ji lta ji ltar rnam bsams pa/ / de lta de ltar mgon khyod la/ / bdag gi sems 'di dad par gyur/ / de ltar thams cad mkhyen min pa'i/ / grub mtha'i skyon gyis brlag sems ldan/ /bsams rlag rnams kyis skyon med pa'i/ / ston pa khyod kyang mi mthong ngo /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa dang bstan pa gzhan gyi skyon mthong nas rgyab kyis phyogs pa zhig med par thams cad la dag snang sbyong ba'i zob byed pa ni rang gi ston pa la blo ma khel shing yon tan ma mthong ba yin no/ / de ltar nakhyad par 'di bzhis snga ma snga ma la zhib cha 'don tshul shes na go rgyu shin tu che'o/ / 'di dag ni skyabs 'gro thams cad la med mi rung gi khyad par yin zhing / theg chen gyi skyabs 'gror 'gyur ba la de'i steng du mdo sde rgyan las/kun tu 'gro dang khas len rtogs dang zil gnon par dbye ba'i rang bzhin 324

sa / /kyisasangagro'i 'i'i brnabakhasal117godon rnams bzhi yi khyad par gyis/ / theg pa mchog phyir skyabs rab song ba gang yin pa/ / de nyid skyabs su song ba rnams kyi mchog ces bya/ / zhes mdorabastan cing / gang zhig sems can thams cad bsgral bar zhugs pa dang / zhes sogs kyis rgyas par bshad pa'i khyad par rnams tshang dgos so/mdor na skyabs 'gro'i gdams pa ni thams cad la gal che ba dang / skyes bu mchog 'bring dman pa gang yin kyang rang gi blo tshod dang 'tsham par byar yod cing / so so'i nyams len thams cad skyabs 'gro'i khongs su bsdus nas byas chog pa'i man ngag khyad par can yin te/ gzhung lugs la ma sbyangs pa'i tha mal ba rnams kyang mchog gsum bslu ba med par dam pa rnams kyis gsungs pa la yid ches byas nas skyid sdug ci byung yang khyed mkhyen snyam pa byas naskyabs su 'gro tshul zhig yin la der yang phan yon che ste/ rgyud rtog pa gsum pa las/ yang na blun po dad pa brtan/ / de la spyor ba'i dngos grub nye/ /gsungs pa ltar ro/ skyes bu chung ngu'i lam la blo sbyang ba rnams ni mi rtag pa dang ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pas rgyu byas dngos gzhi dkon mchogagasum la skyabs su 'gro zhing de'i bslab bya las 'bras kyi blang dor la 'bad na chung ngu'i chos skor thams cad der 'du/ 'bring gis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'i nges 'byung gis rgyu byas te ston pa sangs rgyas kyi rjes su zhugs nas lam bslab pa gsum la slob dgos pas de thams cad kyang skyabs 'gro'i khongs su 'du/ skyes bu chen po rnams ni phar phyin bsdu ba las/sems can rnams la snying brtse zhing / bde gshegs yon tan thob mos na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ / mdor bsdus skyabs su song ba yin/ /byang chub mchog gi phyogs kyi chos/ / bdag don ma yin gzhan don du/ / snying rje chen po spyod byed na/ / chos la skyabs su song ba yin/325

/zhes sogs ltar snying rjes yid bskyed de gzhan don du rang gi 'bras skyabs su gyur pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid gtso bor don du gnyer zhing / de'i rgyur thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob pa yin pas de'ang skyabs 'gro'i khongs su 'du/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i skabs sangs rgyas 'bras skyabs su bzung ba tsam gyis kyang mi chog par de la lta nas nga rgyal bzhag ste 'bras bu lam byed kyi tshul du bsgom zhing mtshan bcas mtshan med rim gnyis sogs kyi chos la slob pa dang / dge 'dun yang dpa' po mkha' 'gro rnams pho nya'i grogs su bsten cing chos srung rnams kyis 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / rang gis kyang 'phrin las bzhi'i sgo nas gzhan don mkha' khyab tu sgrub pa'i rten 'brel da lta nas bsgrigs pa yin pas de thams cad kyang skyabs 'gro'i nyams len las ma 'das shing / mdor na lung rtogs kyi bstan pa thams cad skyabs 'gro'i chos skor du gtogs pa yin te/ rgyud bla dar ṭīka las/ skyabs 'gro 'di la go ba legs par chags na gsung rab dgongs 'greladang bcas pa ma lus pa skyabs 'gro bcas pa'i yan lag tu shes par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na sangs rgyas kyis nye ring mdzad pa min yang rang rang gis skyabs su 'gro tshul rgya che chung gi dbang gis gnas skabs kyi 'jigs pa phran tshegs dang ngan song 'khor ba sogs las skyob tshul gye rim pa du ma byung ba yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang / / ngan song dang ni thabs min dang / / 'jig tshogs theg pa dman pa las/ / skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa da ji ltar lag tu len pa'i tshul dngos ni/ jo bo gser gling pa'i3ma thar las 'byung ba ltar gnas khang byi dor legs par byas/ sa 326

da / //pa bab tsho 'ipapa tha bsgo 'gazhir me tog sil ma dgram/ dri zhim po'i chus chag chag gdab/ stegs bzang po la bstan pa'i bdag pos gtso byas pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan bris 'bur ci rigs sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten gang 'byor bsham/de dag gi mdun du ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa rnams g.yo med cing bkod pa legs par mdzes pa gtsang spras thon pa bsham/ bde ba'i stan la spyod lam tshul mthun gyis 'khod de rang rgyud la brtag nas/ da res mi lus thob kyang blo bde ba'i gdeng tshad sems la 'dzin rgyu ci'ang ma byas/ nyes lhung sgo du ma nas bsags pa ni mtha' yas pas nam dbugs kyi rgyu ba 'di 'gags ma thag ngan song du ltung ba las 'os mi 'dug cing / der skyes na sdug bsngal bzod glag med pa'i tshul bsam ste shin tu 'jigs shing skrags pa dang / de nas rang gi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mtha' skor du rigs drug gi sems can mtha' yas pas bskor ba/ de thams cad kyang drin can gyi ma sha stag yin tshul dang rang nyams la dpag pa'i snying rje shugs drag po bskyed de/ de thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i dge sems khyad par can de'i ngang nas skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/rang gi mdun gyi thad drang gi nam mkha'i gnas su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri mtho zhing yangs pa'i steng khar sna tshogs pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btsom lta bu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ sku la chos gos gsum mdzes par gsol ba/ 'od kye phung po'i dkyil na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / de'i thugs gar 327

/ /hūṃ yig sngon po 'od zer 'phro ba thub dbang gi rgyab ngos kyi steng du seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ge rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ g.yas phyogs su rje btsun byems pa la rgya chen spyod brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ g.yon phyogs su rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ mdun du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la chos 'brel yod pa tshogam rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de dag gi mtha' skor du yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' po dpa' mo bstan srung ye shes pa'i tshogs rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de dag rang rang gi mdun na gdan khri phun tshogs la rang rang gis gsungs pa'i lung gi chos rnams 'od kyi rang bzhin can gyi po ti'i rnam par yod pa/ de dag gi phyi rol tu gang la gang 'dul gye sprul pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs bcur 'phro ba/thams cad kyang rang nyid la dgyes pa'i nyams dang bcas te bzhugs par bsam/ rang dang sems can thams cad kyang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs pa dang dkon mchog gi yon tan mthong ba'i sgo nas mgrin gcig tu skyabs 'gro byed par bsams te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bogru gyur ba chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/zhes dang / bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan gang mang brjod cing gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas/ bla ma thub pa'i dbang po dang dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan sems 328

da / / :re go // rnyecan thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas nyes lhung sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du bla ma'i sku la bsngo ba gsung bcags thugs dkrug pa la sogs pa bla ma la brten pa'i nyes pa thams cad dag lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ khyad par bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rang gzhan thams cad la zhugs pas bla ma'i skyabs 'og tu chud song snyam pa bya/ de nas/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan gang mang brjod cing gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas/ rdo rje 'chang sogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas sdeg sgrib dag khyad par de bzhig gshegs pa'i sku la ngan sems kyi khrag phyung ba/ sku blus zos pa/ legs nyes kyi dpyad brtag pa/ gcug lag khang dang mchod rten bshigs pa sogs sangs rgyas la brten nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag sangs rgyas la brten nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi phyin rlabs rang gzhan thams cad la zhugs pas de'i skyabs 'og tu chud par bsams/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan gang mang brjod cing gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas/ chos po ti rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas sdig sgrib spyi dang khyad par du gsung rab rnams zong du byas pa/ gta' mar bcug pa/sa sgre mo la bzhag pa/ 'gom yug byas pa sogs dang / lhag par yang chos dang chos smra ba la smad pa/ bshad sgrub kyi gegs byas sogs chos spong gi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas de'i skyabs 'og tu chud pa'i dmigs pa byed/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan gang mang brjod cing 329

/ /gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pa'i tshe/ byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo dpa' mo bstan srung ye shes pa'i tshogs rnams kye sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas/dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa/ dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'bag pa/ skur ba btab pa sogs dge 'dun dkon mchog la brten nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag dge 'dun dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og tu chud song snyam du bsam la dga' ba skyed/ yi dam chos srung rnams logs su byed na/yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan gang mang brjod cing gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas/yi dam rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan thams kyi lus sems la zhugs pas/ rigs lnga spyi bye brag gi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag nas yi dam rnams kyi byen rlabs zhugs te rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad can rnams skye ba'i snod rung du gyur par bsam/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / zhes lan gang mang brjod cing gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas/ mgon po phyag drug pa sogs chos srung rnams kyi sku las 'od zer me 'od lta bu 'phros nas rang gi lus la zhugs pas sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad bsregs te ro med du byas/ chos srung rnams kyi byin rlabs rang gi lus sems la zhugs pas phyin chad nad rims gdon bgegs sogs gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i srung ba chen por gyur pa'i dmigs pa byed/mdo lugs kho na ltar byed na gong ma rnams kyi tshe'ang bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang mi byed par de dag las 'od 'phros te rang la phog pas byin gyes brlabs pa dang/zhal nas/ khyed cag 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgol ba'i mgon 3༅

ra / /kyis 'is gasnyebs ya'i/tshogasaskyabs dpung gnyen nged rnams kyis bya'o/ / zhes gsung lhang lhang byon nas zhal gyis bzhes par bsam la dga' ba dang / slar yang lus kye ba spu g.yo zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrug pa'i dang ba shugs drag po gsal btab kyin skyabs 'gro byed/ de ltar so sor byas te thun mong du skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni dper na dmag la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa chen po byung ba'i tshe bza' tshang gi dpon des rang gcig pu ci thar mi byed par gnyen bshes rnams kyi mgo 'don pa ltar sems can rnams kyi don gtso bor yid la bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ / byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / zhes lan gang mang brjod cing gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas/ tshogs zhing thams cad kyi sku'i cha las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phen zhing rgyas/khyad par dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs rang gzhan thams cad la zhugs par bsam/ de nas/ bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ skabs 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces lan gang mang brjod cing sems bskyed shugs drag tu bsgoms pas/ thub pa'i dbang po'i sku las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad nas rang nyid la thim pas rang nyid kyang thub pa'i dbang po'i skur lam gyis gyur/ rang nyid thub dbang du gyur pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ mtha' skor na yod pa'i pha ma sems can thams cad la phog pas so so'i sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs nas thams cad thub dbang gi go 'phang la bkod par bsams te sems skyed 'bras bu lam byed kyi tshul du bsgom/ 'di tsam sher mdo'i gleng gzhi sogs 331

/su skad cig der ngan song stong par gsungs pa dang mthun cing / gtsug na rin chen gyi mdo las bdag gi lus sems can thams cad kyi lus su mos/sems can thams cad kyi lus sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gnas su mos par gsungs pa dang don mthun pas mdo lugs pa rkyang pa la'ang 'gal ba med par rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal nas gsungs so/ / de nas mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i rgyun bshags sam yan lag bdun par grags pa/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs kyang 'di'i dkyus su 'don srol yod pa bzhin byed na tshig ris kyi rim pa ltar/ thams cad kyi gzhi rten zhing sa lta bu'i skyabs 'gro dang zhing la rdo dang gzeg ma sogs sel ba bzhin du 'gal rkyen sdig pa bshags pa dang /der chu lud 'dren pa ltar rjes su yi rang gi sgo nas mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa dang / de nas sa bon lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang / de rjes sems can thams cad kyi nyer 'tsho'i rten du gyur pa'i byang chub kyi spyod pa'i lo tog spel ba sogs kyi dmigs rnam rgyud 'khul nges bya/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi sgom pa ni sems skyed kyi dmigs rnam de nyid je rgyas su gtong ba yin te/ sems skyed skabs sems can thams cad kyi don bya'o snyam pa'i don ni sdug bsngal sel ba dang bde ba sgrub pa gnyis las ma 'das shing /sdug bsngal sel bar 'dod pa la snying rje/ bde ba sgrub par 'dod pa la byams pa/ bde ba'ang zag bcas kyi bde ba tsam la yid brtan med pa mthar slu ba'i chos can yin pas/ zag med kyi bde dga' nam yang mi nyams pa zhig la 'god par 'dod pa dga' ba/ de'ang phyogs ris can ma yin par dgra gnyen bar ma kun la snyoms pa zhig dgos pas btang snyoms te bzhir phye ba yin no/ /332

da / ////bar sha//khodes na de sgom tshul ni/ ma rgan sems can 'di rnams thog ma med pa nas bde ba kho na 'dod kyang de'i rgyu ma bsgrubs pas bde ba rnal ma gcig dang ma phrad par 'dug da lta bde bar rlom pa bag re yod na'ang myur du sdug bsngal du 'gyur nas 'gro bas bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na ci ma rung / ldan par gyur cig ces byams pa dang / 'di rnams thog med nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myangs shing da lta'ang myong bzhin du de'i rgyu sgrub par 'dug pas sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral na ci ma rung / bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang / 'di rnams sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu thams cad dang ma bral na ci ma rung / mi 'bral bar gyur cig de lta bu byung na dga' 'o ang snyam du dga' ba dang 'di rnams kyis thog med nas phan tshun du 'ga' zhig la nye bar bzung / 'ga' zhig la ring bar bzung nas chags sdang gis las ngan sna tshogs bsags pa'i dbang gis spyir 'khor ba dang / khyad par ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal dpag med phyong bar 'dug 'di rnams phan tshun la nye ring du bzung ste chags sdang gi sems dang bral nas btang snyoms la gnas na ci ma rung / gnas par gyur cig bdag gis kyang 'di rnams las kha cig la nye ba dang / kha cig la ring bar bzung nas chags sdang mi byed par thams cad la sems snyoms par bya'o/ / zhes btang snyoms kyi dmigs pa rnams gsal btab la/ ngag tu/ ma sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad nye ring chag sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig333

/ /ces tshad med bzhi shugs drag tu bsgoms pas tshogs zhing thams cad kyi sku lasabadud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med byung nas pha ma sems can thams cad la phog pas nye ring chags sdang la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib las nyon thams cad dang des bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa sbyangs/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thob cing tshad med bzhi la gnas par gyur song snyam du bsam mo/ / btang snyoms ni dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las 'byung ba ltar rgya che bas mjug tu bzhag pa yin kyang / sher phyin gyi mdo dang mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las rnam dzogs spyor ba'i drod kyi skabs su mnyam pa'i sems sogs bcu gsungs pa ltar jo bo'i man ngag gis sems snyoms pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ ngag tu brjod skabs kyang / sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral pa'i gtang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces sngon du blangs nas 'don pa'i phyag bzhes kyang yod pas gang mos bya/ de nas zab rgyas kyi lam la gshad sgom dang 'brel pa'i dad pas kun nas bslangs te/ gang gis rten zhes sogs 'don/ khrus gsol byed na khrus khang gsal btab ste der spyan drangs la lha rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas sku khrus gsol ba dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang rgyan 'bul ba'i dmigs pa sogs tshig ris ltar bya/ spro na yan lag bdun pa rgyas par byas la maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma'am bdun ma dbul/ yon tan gzhir gyur ma'am don chen po gsum gyi sgo nas gsol ba gdab/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mtha' skor na bzhugs pa'i tshogs zhing rnams la phog pas thams cad 'od du zhu nas thub dbang la thim thub dbang rang gi smin mtshams su thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa bya'o/3ma

da / //pa/batha gyi 'i ——17mjug tu dge ba rnams bzang po spyod pa sogs kyi sgo nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi smon gnas rnams su 'dun pa drag pos bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o/ /gsum pa skyabs su song ba'i phan yon la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi lam rim las/ skyabs 'gros sangs rgyas bar tshud sdom pa kun/ / skye ba'i rten du 'gyur zhing sngon bsags kyi/ / las sgrib thams cad srab cing zad par 'gyur/ / skyabs song bsod nams blo yis gzhal mi nus/ / ngan 'gror mi lhung mi dang mi min gyi/ / bar chad dag gis mi tshugs ci bsam 'grub/ / myur du 'tshang rgya'i phan yon brgyad bsam nas/ / nyin dang mtshan du skyabs 'gro lan gsum bya/ / zhes pa ltar brgyadalas/ dang po nang pa sangs rgyas bar tshud pa ni/ spyir phyi ba dang nang pa'i khyad par 'jog tshul mang po bshad kyang / mnyam med jo bo chen po dang shārnyi ba gnyis kyis skyabs 'gro'i sgo nas 'jog par gsungs/ jo bo chen po bod kyi rgyal blon rnams kyis dka' tshegs chen pos spyan drangs skabs kyang bod ston rnams gsang sngags zab mo'i chos 'di las lhag pa med zer ba'i kha bo can zhig gsung du re'ang / jo bo chen pos ma mdzangs kyis bu gso ba'am/ nad pa lus zungs gso ba bzhin slob ma'i rgyud tshod dang 'tsham pa zhig dgos par gzigs nas skyabs 'gro las 'bras kyi chos skor 'dikho na gsung bas mtshan la'ang bla ma skyabs 'gro pa dang las 'bras par grags pa byung ste/ de tsam gyis kyang bstan pa'i dmigs ltos dang rjes 'jug gi nyams len la phan pa chen po byung ngo / bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por rlom zhing kun gyis de ltar bkur na'ang nang du skyabs 'gro rnams ngag cig med na phyi nang go 'dzol nas/ gnas brtan zhal mar 335

/ /gzigs shig 'dug ste sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgo nang du ma tshud 'dug ces pa'i dper 'gro nyen yod ces rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsungs so/ / gnyis pa sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba ni mdzod 'grel las/ skyabs su 'gro ba rnams ni sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa thams cad la sgor gyur pa yin no/ / zhes dang / rtsa bar/ gzhan la bsnyen gnas yod mod kyi/ / skyabs su ma song pa la med/ / ces sdom pa gong 'og kun gyi rten med mi rung du gsungs te/ sa bon mang nyung gang 'debs kyang rang tshod kyi zhing sa re dgos pa khyad med pa ltar sdom pa so so la rten rgya che chung gi skyabs 'gro re gzhir byed dgos pas/ 'bog chog rnams las skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byas zhes pa'i don yang de yin no/ /gsum pa sngon bsags pa'i sdig sgrib zad par 'gyur ba ni/ lam rim chen mo las/ phag tu skye bar 'gyur pa'i lha'i bus skyabs 'gro byas pas der ma skyes pa lta bu ste skyabs 'gro byas pas ngan 'gro'i rgyu dag pa'i phyir ro/zhes gsungs te/ sdig pa chen po che byas nas ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar ltung du nye ba'ang lha dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs la 'chang du yod pa'i dus 'dir blo 'gel nus na 'jigs pa de las thar pa la tshegs med pas 'bad rigs pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang / / dpa' la rten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar/ / gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba/ / de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa bsod nams rgya chen po gsog pa ni/ phan phyin bsdus pa las/skyabs song bsod nams gzugs yod na/ / khams gsum 'di yang snod du chung / / rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ / phul gyis gcal bar gzhal mi nus/336

ra / /sa babacangs tshor la /sgo khezhes gzugs su grub na nam mkha'i khyon la'ang mi shong bar gsungs so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ni 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan bsam mi khyab/ / dam pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bsam mi khyab/ / bsam mi khyab la dad rnams kyi/ / rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ ces dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad tshad med pa de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa la yon phul ba'ang tshad med do/ /mtha' yas so/ / bsam gyes mi khyab bo/ / mtshungs pa med do/ / grangs med do/ / zhes yul dkon mchog gi yon tan dang thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang gis de la brten pa'i bsod rnams kyi phung po'ang bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang zad pa med par gsungs te/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las kyang mi zad pa'i sgra don gye skabs ched du bya ba sems can zad mi shes pa dang dmigs yul byang chub kyi yon tan zad mi shes pa'i dbang gis de la brten pa'i dge rtsa rnams mi zad par gsungs pa dang rgyu mtshan 'dra'o/ / des na bsod nams kyi zhing sa mtshungs zla med pa ni dkon mchog gsum kho nar nges te/ chos thams cad kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ / dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa/ / yon gyi gnas 'ga' yod ma yin/ / zhes so/ /lnga pa ngan 'gror mi ltung ba ni/ mdo las/ gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs dang po/ / de dag ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur/ /mi yi lus ni spangs nas su/ / de dag lha yi lus 'thob bo/ / zhes chos dang dge 'dun la'ang sbyar nas gsungs pa dang ngan 'gror skyes zin pa'i rjes su dkon mchog la skyabs su song na'ang de las myur du thar par 'gyur ba'i tshul/ ngan song 337

/ /sbyong rgyud las/ e ma'o sangs rgyas kye sangs rgyas/ e ma'o sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ / gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ / byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag / ces ched du brjod pa byas pa bzhin no/ /drug pa mi dang mi ma yin gyi bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa ni/ mdo las/'jigs pas skrag pa'i mi rnams ni/ / phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang / / kun dga' dang ni mchod gnas kyi/ / ljon shing rnams la skyabs 'gro ste/ / skyabs de gtso bo ma yin zhing / / skyabs de mchog gyur ma yin la/ / skyabs de la ni brten nas kyang / / sdug bsngal kun las mi 'grol zhing / / gang tshe gang zhig sangs rgyas dang / / chos dang dge 'dun skyabs song la/ / zhes pa nas/ skyabs de la ni brten nas kyang / sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur/ / zhes dang / rgyal po mya ngan med kyis klu btul ba'i le'u las/ kye ma dkon mchog gsum mchod pa'i/ / 'bras bu ci 'dra 'di gzigs shig / rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa'i klu/ / bdag gis btul cing 'di dbang bgyis/ / chu dang mkha' la 'gro ba'i klu/ /bsod nams kyis ni ngas pham byas/ / sa la gnas pa'i dgra yi tshogs/ /bsod nams kyis ni zad par byed/ / ces chos rgyal mya ngan med la rgya mtsho'i klu rnams kyis tho brtsams pa'i tshe dkon mchog mchod pa'i stobs kyis de dag gis ma tshugs shing tshur dbang du 'dus pa dang / dge bsnyen zhig la mu stegs pa'i ngan sngags mkhan zhig gis rlung zhags btang ba'i tshe dkon mchog la skyabs su song bas rlung zhags gtong mkhan la phyir log pa'i gtam rgyud lta bu yin no/ /bdun pa ci bsam 'grub pa ni/ chos ldan gyi bya ba gang sgrub pa'i thog mar dkon mchog la mchod cing skyabs su song nas 'grub par gsol ba 338

ra / /— ba (41'i thab yo 'i/stenasabatab na bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur bas/ dam pa rnams bstan bcos rtsom pa sogs kyi thog mar mchod brjod mdzad pa'i dgos pa'ang de yin la/de'i rgyu mtshan ni skyabs su song bas bsod nams rlabs po che gsog pa dang /bsod nams kye dbang gis 'dod don smon pa bzhin 'grub pa yin te/ rgya cher rol pa las/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ / bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yis bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /ces dang / sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu ba'i mdo las/ 'jig rten dag ni bde zhing skyid pa/ / de kun dkon mchog mchod las 'byung bas/ / de bas bde zhing skyid pa 'dod pas/ / dkon mchog mchod la rtag tu brtson bya/ /zhes bde skyid legs tshogs thams cad 'grub pa dkon mchog kho nar rag las par gsungs so/ /brgyad pa myur du 'tshang rgya ba ni/ lam rim chen mor/ seng ges zhus pa las/ dad pas mi khom spong bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar dal ba khyad par can rnyed cing skyabs dang mjal nas lam khyad par can la slob la des ni ring por mi thogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ / zhes gsungs te/rgyan las chos sku'i 'azin las kyi skabs su dang por 'gro ba zhi ba'i 'phrin las zhes ngan song gsum sogs mi khom pa'i gnas las drangs te mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan pa'i rten bzang po la bkod nas rim gyis mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god dgos par gsungs pa dang gnad 'dra zhing / de thams cad kyang dkon mchog gi thugs rje kho na la brten pa yin te/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis/ mtho ris thong byed ngan song spong / / mi yis rtag tu bsten bya ste/ / e ma'o sangs rgyas e ma'o chos/ / e ma'o bstan pa phun sum tshogs/ / zhes gsungs shing / sangs rgyas la brten pa'i bsod 339

༄/ /nams cung zad tsam zhig yin kyang mthar byang chub gyi rgyur nges par 'gro ste/mdo sde pad dkar las/ mchod rten de la gang gis thal mo sbyar/ / yongs su tshang ba'am thal mo ya gcig gam/ / yang na mgo po skad cig 'dud pa dang / / de bzhin lan gcig lus kyang 'dud pa dang / / gang gi ring bsrel gnas pa de dag la/ / g.yeng ba'i sems kyis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ tshig gcig lan 'ga' brjod par byas pa yang / de dag kun gyis byang chub mchog 'di 'thob/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'di dag ni man ngag nas 'byung ba'i phan yon 'dus che la dngos zin go bde ba'i dbang gis bla ma rnams kyis khrid rgyun la gtso bor gsung pa bzhin bkod pa yin zhing / bsdu ba las/ bsod nams chen po 'thob pa/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i dga' ba dang mi 'bral ba/ ting nge 'dzin brtan po rnyed pa/shes rab kyi mthus srid pa las grol ba bzhi dang / dkar phyogs kyi lha la sogs pa'i srung ba chen po dang ldan pa/ grogs ngan sogs la brten nas bsags pa'i sdig pa zad pa/ skyes bu dam pa'i grangs su tshud pa/ lha rnams dga' bar 'gyur ba dang bzhi ste brgyad gsungs so/ / de ltar phan yon rnams la blo legs par goms na tsha bas gdungs pa'i glang po che pad mtshor 'jug pa bzhin gzhan gyis bskul mi dgos par ngang gis skyabs 'gro la 'jug pa dang / de'i bslab bya rnams la'ang khur gyi 'du shes med par rgyan du go bas srung ba la tshegs med pa zhig 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ni/ dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / der skyabs su song ba tsam gyis mi chog gaskyabs 'gro'i bslab bya la legs par slob dgos te/ dper na dgra ma rung bas gtses pa'i tshe rgyal po chen po sogs la mgon btsal na des skyob nus rma

ra / // ba 04sgo'i ba go /sgonasakyang / rgyal po de nyid kyi bka' khrims ma brtsis na der yang chad pa 'phog pa bzhin/ dkon mchog la skyabs su song yang de'i bslab bya las 'bras kyi blang dor sogs sangs rgyas kyi bka' khrims bzhin du ma bsrungs na dkon mchog gis kyang skyob thabs dang bral 'gro ba chos nyid yin pas bslab bya'i rim pa 'di la nan tan snying por byas te 'bad dgos so/ / de'ang bsdu ba las/ bshes gnyen dam pa bsten pa/ de las chos nyan pa/ chos kyi don yid la byed pa/ de thar pa'i rgyur 'gro nges su bsgrub pa bzhi dang / sgo gsum bag med du mi gtong ba/ bslab gzhi ci nus su 'dzin pa/ snying rje'i dbang gis sems can gzhan yang de la sbyor ba/ bka' drin rjes su dran nas rtag tu dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa dang bzhi ste/ brgyad gsungs so/ /'di rnams ni grong khyer chen po'i lcags ri bzhin mtha' nas bsrung ste nyes ltung 'gog tshul rgya chen po'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ las dngapo par gnad thog tu me btsa' btab pa bzhin 'byung nye ba'i dgag bya rnams dmigs phug ste 'gog tshul dang / lag len yang 'phral du gang gtso ngos bzung nas bstan na phan che bas 'dir man ngag nas 'byung ba bzhin bshad pa la gnyis/ so so'i bslab bya dang / thun mong gi bslab bya'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dgag pa'i bslab bya dang / bsgrub pa'i bslab bya'o/dang po ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa las/ gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te/ / nam du'ang lha ni gzhan dag la/skyabs su song ba ma yin no/ / dam pa'i chos la skyabs 'gro ba/ / 'tshe zhing gsod pa'i sems dang bral/ / dge 'dun la yang skyabs 'gro ba/ /mu stegs can dang 'grogs pa min/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas ma1

/ /la skyabs su song bas 'jig rten pa'i lha la gtan gyi skyabs mi 'tshol/de'ang tshangs pa dang dbang phyug sogs la'ang gtan gyi skyabs mi 'tshol na/yi dwags kyi rigs su gyur pa'i lha 'dre la skyabs mi 'tshol ba lta ci smos/gzhi bdag sogs la gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe snying rje'i bsam pa dang gnas skabs kyi grogs 'tshol ba'i bsam pas gtong zhing phugs kyi re ltos mi 'cha' ba gal che ste/ gnas skabs kyi bya ba phran bu re'i grogs byas pa la mgo 'khor te gtan gyi 'dun ma'i rtsa ba 'phyugs na nyen shin tu che/ chos la skyabs su song na chos dang mthun zhing mu stegs can gyi gzhung sogs log pa'i chos la yid brtan mi 'cha'/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba'i grogs mu stegs can dang mi 'grogs shing / las 'bras la yid mi ches shing chos la skur ba 'debs pa'i mi dang mdza' grogs mi byed de/ dam tshig nyams pa dang 'grogs na de'i nyams grib kyis yon tan thams cad 'grib cing dngos grub kyi sgo 'gag par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i bslang bya ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs ri mor bris pa dang 'bur du dod pa gang la'ang bzang ngan dang legs nyes sogs kyi skyon mi gdags par bdag 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i ston pa thugs rje can de'i sku'o snyam du gus pa skyed cing phyag dang mchod pa sogs bya/ da lta rang cag la chos ston pa sogs mi mdzad pa ni rang gi las snang ma dag pa'i dbang gis ma mthong ba yin gyi ston pa'i nus pa med pa min te/ sar gnas kyi sems dpa' rnams la sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan mtha' dag gis chos ston pa sogs mdzad par mdo sde rgyan las gsungs so/ / des na bzo dang rgyu sogs la ma ltos par skyabayoyul mchog tu 'dzin dgos te bshes spring las/ ji ltar bde gshegs sku gzugs shing las kyang / bgyis pa ci 'dra yang rung mkhas 342

sa / /kyisaba'agro'i 'ib skyabazangabaka'aphe117gopas mchod/ / ces gsungs so/ / dam pa'i chos tshig bzhi ba zhig yan chad la 'gom yug dang sa sgre bo la 'jog pa dang bzang ngan gye skyon rtog sogs spong zhing / bdag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las sgrol bar byed pa'i skyabs dngos de 'di'o snyam du gus pa skyed cing phyag dang mchod pa sogs bya/ da lta gzhung lugs pa cung zad sbyangs bar rlom pa 'ga' zhig chosadakon mchog la 'gog lam gang rung gis khyab pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas lung gi chos rnams skyabs yul du mi rtsi ba shin tu mi rung ste/ rgyud las/ blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste/ / dman pas 'jigs pa rnams kyi rgyal byed tshal/ / srid pa'i 'byor pa zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog / gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / zhes chos dkon mchog gi thad du lung gi chos gsungs pa 'di go dgos/ da lta 'di la chos dkon mchog dang skyabs dngos byas nas rang rgyud la ma bsten par 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos dkon mchog dngos de rgyud la skye thabs med pas 'di gal che zhes skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang pos gsungs so/ / de ltar rang gi rgyud tshod dang mthun par chos dkon mchog 'grub pa'i tshul 'di ni rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa rma med pa yin te/ lam rim las/mtha'i chos dkon mchog de'ang las dang po pa'i dus kyi skyon phyogs re tsam spong ba'i spangs pa dang yon tan phyogs re tsam sgrub pa'i rtogs pa gnyis gong nas gong du khyad zhugs par song ba la 'jog gi de las gzhan glo bur du 'byung ba min no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas dge 'dun gyi rtags tsam 'chang ba yan chad thams cad la ma gus pa spong zhing / dge slong bzhi sde yan chad la bdag 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las sgol bar byed pa'i grogs dge 'dun de 'di'o snyam du gus pa skyed 343

/ /cing bsnyen bkur la brtson par bya ste tshul 'chal dge spyong gi rtags 'chang pa la'ang brnyas smod brdeg 'chog sogs byas na ston pa dang bstan pa la ma gus pa'i nyes pa chen por 'gyur ba'i tshul nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo nang / sa'i snying po'i mdo/ zla ba snying po'i le'u sogs las gsungs pa dang / snying rje pad dkar las bskal bzang sangs rgyas snga ma rnams kyi bstan pa la rab byung gi rtags tsam 'chang ba'ang sangs rgyas mos pa tshun chad la grol bar gsung pa'i phan yon dang nyes dmigs kyi sgo du ma nas bsams te gzab dgos so/dge bshes ston pa dang rnal 'byor pa chen pos lhan pa ser po re 'gom pa'i sar yod pa'ang mi 'gom par sprugs nas gtsang sar skyel ba'i phyag len ltar bslab ste/ rang nyid dkon mchog la gus pa de tsam du 'gro ba rnams kyang ranga'i ches cher gus par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ / 'bras bu de 'dra thob par 'gyur/ / zhes so/lhag par da lta chags sdang gi zhe rus then pa la bstan pa'i bya bar sgro btags te khyed tsho dang nged tsho zhes sde ris su bcad nas 'khrugs pa byed pa legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba gcod pa'i nyes dmigs shin tu che'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong gi bslab bya drug las dang po ni skyabs 'gro'i khyad par rnams yang yang gsal btab nas skyabs 'gro mtshan nyid tshang ba la goms par byed pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ ci za cing 'thung gi phud kyis mchod pa ste/ de thams cad dkon mchog gi bka' drin du rjes su dran pa zhig byung nang bzang sa nas dkon mchog la 'bul dgos pa zhig 'byung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ dkon mchog gi yon tan dang bka' drin mthong pa na sems can gzhan rnams kyang snying brtse bas de'i skyabs 'og tu 'jug pas thabs ci nus su byed do/ / bzhi pa ni/ bya ba ci 'dra zhig byed pa dang dgos pa ci 75
